summary: This dataset contains 36,161 observations and 43 variables from the 2024 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS), including socio-demographic characteristics, reproductive history, and COVID-19-related knowledge and symptoms. The primary outcome variable is COVID-19 vaccine uptake, coded as a binary indicator. The dataset was preprocessed using data cleaning, handling missing data, feature engineering, and categorical encoding to enhance predictive performance for supervised machine learning models.
